name: future-seven-t4-pending
description: Unverified migration template for seven T4 cards. It is not evidence of build, execution, communication or performance.

requirements.resident_protocol: current conditional CUDA resident implementation requires CC >= 8.0; current sm_75 does not meet that static requirement

notes: Select a mutually compatible driver, CUDA runtime, Toolkit, Torch/LibTorch and sm_75 operator stack on the new site; do not copy sm_86 binaries.
Check every intended device and actual directional transfer/gradient behavior; seven is a legal placement count without a power-of-two assumption.
Add measured free/capacity bytes per logical device before capacity admission. Do not add the nominal 7 x 16 GiB into one budget.
The launcher may be changed to systemd when the future site has a user manager; no target has been accessed by this template.
